| LoRA-DPO (lora_dpo) | LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05, q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj/gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj | AdamW (TRL default) | 5e-05 | cosine, warmup 0.1 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 4 x 2 = 8 | fp16 autocast | 512 | 3 epoch(s) | 0.1 | base SmolLM2 (adapter disabled) | 42 |
| LoRA-DPO (lora_dpo_1ep) | LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05, q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj/gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj | AdamW (TRL default) | 5e-05 | cosine, warmup 0.1 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 4 x 2 = 8 | fp16 autocast | 512 | 1 epoch(s) | 0.1 | base SmolLM2 (adapter disabled) | 42 |
| LoRA-DPO (lora_dpo_beta05) | LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05, q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj/gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj | AdamW (TRL default) | 5e-05 | cosine, warmup 0.1 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 4 x 2 = 8 | fp16 autocast | 512 | 3 epoch(s) | 0.5 | base SmolLM2 (adapter disabled) | 42 |

Generation (all models): greedy (do_sample=false, temperature/top-p unused), max_new_tokens 512, fp16, batch 16. Main setting: repetition_penalty 1.1 (`configs/generation_rp1.1.yaml`); sensitivity check: repetition_penalty 1.0 (`configs/generation.yaml`). No length penalty, no n-gram blocking. Prompt template: Qwen ChatML with system message "You are a helpful assistant." (`alignment/prompting.py`); SmolLM2 uses its own tokenizer chat template.
